_comment: The emit half of the checker tsconfig. core/tsconfig.json only CHECKS (noEmit): node runs the .ts sources directly by stripping types, so a checkout never needs compiled output. An INSTALL does -- node refuses to strip types for any file under node_modules, so everything the tarball must execute (bin, the check command, the kernel itself, its cubes and spaces) is compiled here to dist/ before npm pack. The one knob that makes .ts-relative imports legal with emit is rewriteRelativeImportExtensions: it rewrites every './x.ts' specifier to './x.js' in the output instead of forbidding the extension.
_includeComment: src only. plugins/ and store/ hold installed artifacts (a checkout runs them in place; an installed pack's TypeScript is loaded from its own directory, outside node_modules), and *.test.ts are the checkout's unit gates -- none of it executes from dist.
